decision.explanation: The question asks for the electoral district associated with Torcy-et-Pouligny. Source D1 explicitly states 'Torcy-et-Pouligny is associated with the electoral district of the canton of Auterive' (D1S4) and supports this with multiple citations (D1S6-D1S13). Source D2 explicitly states 'Torcy-et-Pouligny is part of the canton of Semur-en-Auxois' (D2S5) and supports this with citations (D2S8-D2S12). Both sources provide direct, positive assertions regarding the association/partition of the commune with specific cantons. As per instructions, distinct valid referents and complementary answers (even if contradictory in real-world geography, they are both present as asserted facts in the provided text) must be preserved. Neither claim is contradicted by the other within the provided text to warrant removal; they represent competing assertions from different documents that are both validly extracted as answers to the question based on the source material.
